newsitem.title: CANADA: Kruger sets 10,000 tonne newsprint downtime.
newsitem.headline: Kruger sets 10,000 tonne newsprint downtime.

text.p: Kruger Inc said on Wednesday that it would shut down its number seven newsprint machine in Trois-Rivieres and its number one machine in Bromptomville, both in the province of Quebec, for two weeks in December.
The temporary shutdowns, which were scheduled to allow improvements in quality and productivity at the Kruger facilities, will reduce newsprint output by about 10,000 metric tons, it said.
The company said the shutdowns would bring total newsprint production downtime to 28,000 tonnes in 1996.
